text:
rebecca-partners: Quick sync request 1: partners are asking for a sandbox timeline + legal addendum for the upcoming SDK handshake + telemetry field rename. Need a short partner-friendly plan.

kai-sdks: We can do a 4-step runbook: preview -> sandbox -> canary -> enforcement. Preview blog post, sandbox with sample data, invite-only canary, then full enforce.

omar-eng: For infra, sandbox must be a separate tenant with relaxed rate limits and test-only tokens. We can reuse the `partners-sbx` namespace. Need lead time to provision upstream certs.

trina-hw: HW partners will require an OTA window and test harness. Suggest we publish a certification checklist and 120d certification window.

mike-gtm: GTM wants a partner webinar + joint press timeline. If legal needs addenda (telemetry opt-in changes) we should align the webinar 2 weeks after legal sign-off.

lex-legal: We need to add a short amendment to the partner agreement for telemetry fields and signal retention. We'll draft a one-paragraph addendum and share. Estimated turnaround 7 business days.

rebecca-partners: Good. Can we offer two migration tracks: standard (auto-migrate headers) and strict (clients must send new headers)? Partners pick per-account. That helps SIs with slow rollouts.

kai-sdks: Implementation note: provide CLI helper `rw partners migrate --partner-id P123 --mode strict|standard` and a library shim `rw.compat.enable_for(partner_id)`. We'll include sample code in the sandbox repo.

omar-eng: Ops needs a rollback plan if canary hits error rates > 2%. Flag-bot, can you create a fail-open automation?

flag-bot: flag-bot: Created feature flag `partners/compat/handshake_v3` and automation rule `auto-rollback-on-errrate>2pct` (task #6128).

trina-hw: Also callout: hardware partners need a signed compatibility certificate after passing tests. Add a `compat-certificate: true` flag to partner metadata.

kai-sdks: Sample header snippet for docs:

```
# v2 -> v3 migration
Authorization: Bearer <token>   # deprecated
X-Rw-Client: <id>              # required v3
X-Rw-TS: 1611234567            # telemetry opt-in header
```

Include a note: if `X-Rw-TS` absent, we default to partner-level consent flag.

mike-gtm: For marketplace listings we need version tags on SKUs: `rw-sdk:v3-ready`. Also add a calendar ICS to partner portal for certification slots.

lex-legal: One more: if partners choose strict mode we should record their consent in the partner portal as an explicit checkbox so legal can audit.

rebecca-partners: Action items: Kai -> publish sandbox repo + CLI by next Wed; Omar -> provision sandbox tenant + ops runbook; Trina -> confirm cert checklist and OTA window with HW PMs; Lex -> draft addendum and checkbox language; Mike -> schedule webinar 2w after legal sign-off and prepare marketplace tags.

kai-sdks: I'll post the sandbox repo link here when ready and include a prebuilt Docker image for HW test harness.

omar-eng: Ops will run a tabletop with one SI and a HW partner during canary. I'll propose dates.

rebecca-partners: Thanks. Please call out any changes to timing here. Planning to publish the partner-facing timeline on the partner portal once we have legal ok and the sandbox repo link. :spiral_calendar_pad:
